summary: TELUS Corporation filed a Form 6-K (foreign private issuer current report, the US equivalent of a Form 8-K) furnishing a news release dated November 6, 2026, announcing that its Board approved the appointments of Marc Allera and Bill Thomas as directors effective January 1, 2027. No financial terms, stake, price, premium, advisor, or transaction mechanics were disclosed. The event is a routine board addition, not a forced or abrupt executive departure, so it does not qualify as a management-change special situation; there is no deal or risk-arb angle to monitor.
